minswaps:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the minimum number of adjacent swaps that move an 'S' left over a 'C' to reduce the total beam damage to at most d, returning -1 when this is impossible." minswaps]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> p </REF>: char* "String of 'S' and 'C' characters; may be mutated by the swapping procedure."
        <REF> d </REF>: int "Maximum allowed total damage."
        <REF> len </REF>: int "Number of characters in p."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: int "Minimum number of swaps needed to make damage <= d, 0 if already <= d, or -1 if impossible."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Receive the string p, integer d, and length len. RESULT input]
            [COMMAND If len == 2, apply the two-character boundary cases: if p[0]=='S' and p[1]=='C' return 0; if p[0]=='S' and p[1]=='S' return -1 when d<2 and 0 when d>=2; if p[0]=='C' and p[1]=='S' return 1 when d<2 and 0 when d>=2; otherwise return 0. RESULT return_value]
            [COMMAND For the general case, declare i and temp; initialize strength=1, damage=0, k=0, swaps=0, flag=0; allocate an integer array a of length len. RESULT local_state]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to len-1, if p[i]=='S' add strength to damage and store strength in a[k++]; otherwise multiply strength by 2 and store the new strength in a[k++]. RESULT damage_and_a]
            [COMMAND If damage <= d, return 0. RESULT return_value]
            [COMMAND Set i = len-1. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND While flag == 0, perform an outer pass: at the start of each pass set flag=1 and i=len-1, then run the inner while loop as long as damage-d>0 and i>0. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND Inside the inner loop, while p[i] != 'S', decrement i to locate the nearest S at or before the current position. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Inside the inner loop, if p[i-1]=='S', decrement i and skip the swap for this position. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Inside the inner loop, when p[i-1] != 'S', perform a swap: set flag=0, set p[i]='C', set p[i-1]='S', and subtract a[i] from damage. RESULT damage_after_removal]
            [COMMAND After the swap, update the array a: if i-1==0 set a[i-1]=1 and a[i]=2; otherwise set a[i-1]=a[i-2] and a[i]=2*a[i-1]. RESULT a_updated]
            [COMMAND After the swap, add a[i-1] to damage and increment swaps. RESULT damage_and_swaps]
            [COMMAND After the if/else swap decision, if i==1 and p[i-1]=='S', break out of the inner while loop. RESULT inner_loop_exit]
            [COMMAND After the outer while loop exits, free array a. RESULT memory_freed]
            [COMMAND If damage-d <= 0, return swaps; otherwise return -1. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
